business_summary: Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells beer in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company also provides water, beverages, and other products. The company was formerly known as Shunyi County Brewery and changed its name to Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd. in March 1984. Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Beijing Yanjing Brewery Investment Co., LTD.
business_summary_ko: 북경연경맥주유한회사 중화인민공화국 및 국제적으로 맥주를 제조 및 판매합니다. 회사는 또한 물, 음료 및 기타 제품을 제공합니다. 회사는 이전에 Shunyi County Brewery로 알려졌으며 이름을 Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co.,Ltd로 변경했습니다. 1984년 3월. 북경연경맥주유한공사. 1980년에 설립되었으며 중화인민공화국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 북경연경맥주유한회사 Beijing Yanjing Brewery Investment Co., LTD의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
